verdict.rationale: No dedicated bulk-operation feature is documented. The closest evidence is the MCP toolset's execute_sql for writes and migrations, which implies an AI client could run set-based changes across many database rows at once, and the docs confirm this toolset is reachable through an official remote MCP server. missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action capability across projects or items (batch edits, multi-select operations), documentation of batch semantics or limits, a public API for scripted bulk operations (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
